name: The Colossal Void-Devourer
power: The bones of an extinct sauropod-crocodile, raised into motion by prana worked through Asura rites and crowned with a cursed human visage. Whatever moved it once, it is a single thing that was made, not a kind of animal that lives.
risk: It lies embedded in basalt now, overgrown and draped in violet moss, and is visited as a landmark. What the rite that raised it could do again is the question nobody who studies it wants answered.
notes: Moved out of the bestiary by the owner's ruling of 29 September 2026: canon makes it one construct raised from bones rather than a living species, so it does not belong in the fauna pool and a player no longer meets it on the road. It was `fauna_colossal_void_devourer` (Sauropodoligator titan, mythic, wetland and river). Paint it as an overgrown bone skeleton set in volcanic basalt under violet moss -- a historical landmark rather than a roaming predator.
